name: an account's series is the value its broker states each day; a day's flow is the change in the net deposits it states; the return is net of it
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series; Yearly return (daily returns net of deposits and withdrawals)
working: the series is the stated value each day: 1000, 1030, 1545, 1500
flow = change in stated net deposits since the stated day before: 01-05 is the first stated day, none (null); 01-06 0; 01-07 1500 − 1000 = 500; 01-08 0

name: holdings and trades on the record do not change the stated series, and no close is needed for it
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series (Wealthsimple's stated value)
working: the series is the broker's stated value, not a valuation of the record: 1000, 1100, 1045
net deposits stay 1000: 01-05 is the first stated day, flow none (null); 0 on 01-06 and 01-07

name: a day the broker states a value but no net deposits has no flow, and no return is formed into it or out of it
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series; Yearly return
working: the series is the stated value each day: 1000, 1100, 1210, 1331
01-05: the first stated day, flow none (null)
01-07: no stated net deposits, so no flow is known (null) and no return is formed
01-08: the stated day before (01-07) states no net deposits, so no flow is known (null) and no return is formed

name: a day the broker states nothing is not in the series; the next day's return is over the last stated day, net of the deposits between
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series; Yearly return
working: the series is the stated days only: 01-05 1000, 01-06 1000, 01-09 1650; 01-07 and 01-08 are not in it
01-05: the first stated day, flow none (null)
01-09: flow = 1500 − 1000 (net deposits at the stated day before, 01-06) = 500
01-09's return is over 01-06's 1000, the 500 counting at the end of the day: (1650 − 500) ÷ 1000 − 1 = 0.15

name: an account whose broker states no value has no series
spec: SPEC.md §2 Equity and returns: Equity series
working: A: stated 500, 550; flow none on 01-05, the first stated day (null), 0 on 01-06; return 550 ÷ 500 − 1 = 0.1; nothing stated for 01-07
B: its broker states nothing, so it has no series on any day, whatever its deposit on the record
